**1.013: One Sabich.**

- The model that was Sabich (Rolling) is now just Sabich, the default. Sabich (Stable) and Jachnun are no longer offered. If you were using one of them, Hebrish moves to a model you already have, or asks you to download Sabich.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
